variables.name: Colours/Brand/Primary
variables.description: The Goodlord teal. Use for primary button backgrounds, active tab indicators, and brand accents like checkbox ticks and radio dots. Not for body text — for highest-emphasis text use Text/Primary (a separate hierarchy concept, not brand-related).

variables.name: Colours/Status/Error
variables.description: Default error colour. Use for error icons, error message text, and error-state input borders. For text on Error/Subtle backgrounds use Error/Strong (higher contrast); for error background tints use Error/Subtle.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Info
variables.description: Default info colour. Use for info icons, informational message text, and info-state borders. For text/icons on Info/Subtle backgrounds use Info/Strong; for background tints use Info/Subtle.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Success
variables.description: Default success colour. Use for success icons, confirmation message text, and success-state borders. For text/icons on Success/Subtle backgrounds use Success/Strong; for background tints use Success/Subtle.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Warning
variables.description: Default warning colour. Use for warning icons, warning message text, and warning-state borders. For text/icons on Warning/Subtle backgrounds use Warning/Strong; for background tints use Warning/Subtle.

variables.name: Colours/Border/Strong
variables.description: Higher-contrast border — the resting border for form inputs (text fields, select fields, checkboxes, radios). "Strong" describes contrast/visibility, not state. Hover/focus/disabled states of these inputs bind to the Border/Default/Hover, /Focus, /Disabled ladder.

variables.name: Colours/Text/Primary
variables.description: Highest-emphasis text colour. Default for body copy, headings, and primary labels. Despite the shared word "Primary", this is unrelated to Brand/Primary — it describes visual hierarchy, not brand identity.

variables.name: Colours/Text/Inverse
variables.description: White text for dark surfaces — sidebar, dark banners, and filled (teal or charcoal) buttons. Ensures AAA contrast on deep fills. The inverse of Text/Primary.

variables.name: Colours/Text/Secondary
variables.description: Lower-emphasis text — supporting metadata, timestamps, captions, and input placeholders. Pair with Body/Supporting typography. Not for primary readable content. Resolves to the same hex as Status/Neutral, but the roles differ: this is for text hierarchy, that is for status surfaces.

variables.name: Colours/Surface/Raised
variables.description: Card-level surface that sits above Surface/Default. Use for card backgrounds, modal surfaces, dropdown panels, and any container that should appear elevated above the page background.

variables.name: Colours/Surface/Default
variables.description: Page-level background. The lowest surface in the elevation stack — cards, modals, and content blocks sit above this on Surface/Raised. Despite "Default" in the name, white is NOT the default surface — Surface/Raised is the white card-level surface.

variables.name: Colours/Border/Default
variables.description: Lower-contrast border. Used for dividers, secondary button outlines, and card outlines. Note: form inputs do NOT use this as their resting border — they use Border/Strong. The Border/Default/Hover, /Focus, /Disabled state variants nest under this token.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Error/Subtle
variables.description: Muted background tint for error banners, alert backgrounds, and error-state field fills. Pair with Error/Strong for any text or icons sitting on top.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Info/Subtle
variables.description: Muted background tint for info banners and alert backgrounds. Pair with Info/Strong for any text or icons sitting on top.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Success/Subtle
variables.description: Muted background tint for success banners and alert backgrounds. Pair with Success/Strong for any text or icons sitting on top.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Warning/Subtle
variables.description: Muted background tint for warning banners and alert backgrounds. Pair with Warning/Strong for any text or icons sitting on top.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Warning/Strong
variables.description: Highest-emphasis warning colour — primarily for text or icons on Warning/Subtle backgrounds, where the brighter Warning would lack contrast.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Success/Strong
variables.description: Highest-emphasis success colour — primarily for text or icons on Success/Subtle backgrounds, where the brighter Success would lack contrast.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Info/Strong
variables.description: Highest-emphasis info colour — primarily for text or icons on Info/Subtle backgrounds, where the brighter Info would lack contrast.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Error/Strong
variables.description: Highest-emphasis error colour — primarily for text or icons sitting on Error/Subtle backgrounds, where the brighter Error would lack contrast. Same pattern applies to the Strong variants of Info/Success/Warning/Neutral.

variables.name: Colours/Text/Link
variables.description: The action accent colour. Used for link text, tertiary button text, and interactive icons in their resting state. Despite living under Text/, this is a FUNCTIONAL token (it indicates clickability), not a hierarchy token. Pair with Interactive/Hover and Interactive/Disabled for state variants.

variables.name: Colours/Surface/Disabled
variables.description: Background fill for disabled interactive surfaces — cancel buttons, disabled inputs, disabled checkbox/radio. Resolves to the same hex as Status/Neutral/Subtle but means something different: use Surface/Disabled when the meaning is "unavailable"; use Status/Neutral/Subtle when the meaning is "neutral status".

variables.name: Colours/Border/Default/Hover
variables.description: Hover state of Border/Default. Applied when a bordered element (card, secondary button) is hovered, to reinforce interactivity. Pair with Border/Default as the rest state.

variables.name: Colours/Border/Default/Focus
variables.description: Focus ring colour — adopts the brand's darker teal so focus state visibly inherits brand identity. Used on focused form inputs and other focusable surfaces.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Neutral/Subtle
variables.description: Muted background tint for neutral status badges and pills. Resolves to the same hex as Surface/Disabled — use this when the meaning is "neutral status"; use Surface/Disabled when the meaning is "unavailable".

variables.name: Colours/Status/Neutral
variables.description: Neutral status indicator — for status badges, pills, or alerts that signal information without success/warning/error connotation. Resolves to the same hex as Text/Secondary but the roles are different: this is for status surfaces; Text/Secondary is for text hierarchy.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Neutral/Strong
variables.description: Highest-emphasis neutral colour — primarily for text or icons on Neutral/Subtle backgrounds, where Neutral would lack contrast.

variables.name: Colours/Brand/Primary/Hover
variables.description: Hover state of Brand/Primary — a slightly darker teal. Used as the background of primary buttons and active links on hover. Pair with Brand/Primary as the rest state.

variables.name: Colours/Brand/Primary/Disabled
variables.description: Disabled state of Brand/Primary — a near-white teal. Used as the BACKGROUND of disabled primary buttons. The contrast drop is intentional; pair with Text/Secondary for the disabled label colour.

variables.name: Colours/Interactive/Hover
variables.description: Hover state of action-coloured text and icons (tertiary button hover, link hover, interactive icon hover). The resting state for these elements is Text/Link — there is intentionally no Interactive/Default.

variables.name: Colours/Interactive/Disabled
variables.description: Disabled state of action-coloured text and icons. Pair with Text/Link as the resting state.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Error/Hover
variables.description: Hover state for error-coloured interactive elements — e.g. danger button hover. Pair with Status/Error as the rest state.

variables.name: Colours/Surface/Hover
variables.description: Hover state for raised surfaces — e.g. Secondary button hover, hoverable cards. Pair with Surface/Raised as the rest state.

variables.name: Colours/Status/Neutral/Hover
variables.description: Hover state for neutral status surfaces — e.g. neutral badge or chip hover. Pair with Status/Neutral as the rest state.

variables.name: Colours/Border/Default/Disabled
variables.description: Disabled state of Border/Default. Muted border for disabled containers and secondary buttons. Pair with Surface/Disabled and Text/Secondary for a complete disabled state.

variables.name: Typography/Heading/H1/Size
variables.description: Page-title size (24px). Goodlord uses three heading levels — H1 for page titles, H2 for parent-card and modal titles, H6 for paragraph leads. H3/H4/H5 are intentionally not defined.

variables.name: Typography/Heading/H1/Weight
variables.description: Weight for H1 page titles. Pair with H1/Size (24px).

variables.name: Typography/Heading/H2/Size
variables.description: Parent-card and modal title size (21px). The middle of Goodlord's three heading levels (H1 page title, H2 card/modal title, H6 paragraph lead).

variables.name: Typography/Heading/H2/Weight
variables.description: Weight for H2 card and modal titles. Pair with H2/Size (21px).

variables.name: Typography/Heading/H6/Size
variables.description: Paragraph-lead / sub-section heading size (16px). The smallest of Goodlord's three heading levels — introduces a block of body copy without the weight of H1 or H2.

variables.name: Typography/Heading/H6/Weight
variables.description: Weight for H6 paragraph leads. Pair with H6/Size (16px).

variables.name: Typography/Body/Single-Line/Size
variables.description: 16px body text without explicit line-height (defaults to 100% leading). Use for SINGLE-LINE UI text — labels, button text, single-line input values, table cells. Not suitable for multi-line copy that may wrap — use Body/Paragraph instead, which has a line-height token for readability.

variables.name: Typography/Body/Single-Line/Weight
variables.description: Weight for single-line body text — labels, button text, table cells. Pair with Body/Single-Line/Size (16px).

variables.name: Typography/Body/Paragraph/Size
variables.description: 16px body text for multi-line copy that may wrap. Use with Paragraph/Line-Height for readability. For single-line UI text use Body/Single-Line instead.

variables.name: Typography/Body/Paragraph/Weight
variables.description: Weight for multi-line paragraph copy. Pair with Body/Paragraph/Size (16px) and Paragraph/Line-Height.

variables.name: Typography/Body/Paragraph/Line-Height
variables.description: Line-height (20px) for multi-line paragraph copy, giving readable leading when text wraps. Single-line body text does not use this — it defaults to 100% leading.

variables.name: Typography/Body/Supporting/Size
variables.description: Smaller, lower-emphasis body text (14px). Used for helper text below form inputs, supporting copy under primary content, secondary information. Pair with Text/Secondary for muted contexts; for error messages use this size + Status/Error colour (typography stays the same — only colour changes).

variables.name: Typography/Body/Supporting/Weight
variables.description: Weight for supporting/helper text. Pair with Body/Supporting/Size (14px).

variables.name: Typography/Body/Error/Size [deprecated — use Body/Supporting]
variables.description: Deprecated 2026-06-09. Identical to Typography/Body/Supporting/Size (both alias the same primitive). Use Typography/Body/Supporting/Size instead. Error styling = Supporting typography + Status/Error colour.

variables.name: Typography/Body/Error/Weight [deprecated — use Body/Supporting]
variables.description: Deprecated 2026-06-09. Identical to Typography/Body/Supporting/Weight (both alias the same primitive). Use Typography/Body/Supporting/Weight instead. Error styling = Supporting typography + Status/Error colour.

variables.name: Typography/Font/Family
variables.description: The product typeface, Brandon Text. Applied across all heading and body type. The single source of truth for font family — components bind here rather than hard-coding the family name.

variables.name: Typography/Label/Size
variables.description: Small text (12px) for badges, pills, chips, and micro-copy. NOT the standard form-field label — form labels use Body/Single-Line/Size (16px). This is for compact UI elements that need smaller text.

variables.name: Typography/Label/Weight
variables.description: Weight for compact label text on badges, pills, and chips. Pair with Label/Size (12px).

variables.name: Radius/xs
variables.description: Extra-small radius (2px). Checkboxes, chips, and badges.

variables.name: Radius/sm
variables.description: Small radius (4px). The default for most UI — buttons, inputs, alerts, and cards nested inside a parent card.

variables.name: Radius/md
variables.description: Medium radius (10px). Top-level containers — parent cards and modals.

variables.name: Radius/full
variables.description: Fully rounded (9999px). Pills, avatars, and circular elements.

variables.name: Colours/Text/Tertiary
variables.description: Lower-emphasis text. Used for prefix/suffix in inputs, ghost/placeholder fallback, helper labels. Below Text/Secondary in the hierarchy.

variables.name: Colours/Text/Inactive
variables.description: Inactive/disabled text — e.g. unselected nav item labels. Aliases Grey/550 (#b3b3b3).

variables.name: Colours/Icon/Default
variables.description: Default resting colour for standalone vector icons (e.g. inactive nav icons). Opens the Icon/* namespace. Aliases Grey/550 (#b3b3b3).

variables.name: Spacing/xxs
variables.description: Tightest gap — label to input (5px)

variables.name: Spacing/xs
variables.description: Small internal gaps, e.g. checkbox to label (10px)

variables.name: Spacing/s
variables.description: Medium-small gaps, e.g. alert padding vertical (15px)

variables.name: Spacing/m
variables.description: Default gap between elements inside a parent card (20px)

variables.name: Spacing/l
variables.description: Section heading to fields within a form section (30px)

variables.name: Spacing/xl
variables.description: Card padding; gap between form sections (40px)
